== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Fox|The Fox]] Mirror is a versatile [[Forger technique]] belonging to the [[Path of the White Fox]]. It functions by creating convincing, though fragile, illusions that can be used for various tactical purposes. Users can manifest the [[technique]] as a deceptive wall to distract enemies, or employ advanced versions that grant complete invisibility by concealing the user's spiritual presence and subtly redirecting the attention of others. While these illusions lack physical substance, they can be combined with other tools, such as a [[Forged]] shield disguised by an illusion of smoke, to provide defensive distractions. The [[technique]] is highly adaptable; for example, it can be used to create decoys that radiate spiritual energy to fool perception or to project an image of a person standing still while the actual user moves undetected. Despite its utility, the illusions are easily broken by physical contact or direct examination by powerful beings like [[Sages]].}}
